PORT ELLERY (March 3) — The Port Ellery Maritime Museum will reopen to the public on Saturday following a two-year renovation that cost $18 million. [1] The project added a glass-roofed gallery overlooking the harbor and restored the museum's original 1890s warehouse building.

choices: The completion of improvements to a museum
A museum's decision to close
A plan to develop the city's harbor
The construction of a new fishing boat for the museum
answer: The completion of improvements to a museum
explanation: 2年間の改修を終えた海事博物館の再開を伝える記事。

format: Part 7 読解問題（シングル）
passage:
Drone Delivery Trial Yields Mixed Results

After a six-month trial in the rural district of Ashcombe, parcel carrier Swiftway has concluded that drone deliveries are feasible for small packages but not yet economical on a large scale.

During the trial, drones completed 4,800 deliveries of medicines and small spare parts to farms and villages, cutting average delivery times from two days to under three hours. [1] Customer feedback was overwhelmingly positive, particularly among farmers who previously had to drive to the nearest town to collect urgent parts.

However, the cost per delivery was roughly four times that of a conventional van route. [2] Strong winds grounded the fleet on 23 of the trial's 180 days, and each drone required a trained operator to monitor its flight, a regulatory requirement that significantly inflated labor costs. [3]

Swiftway's head of innovation, Priyanka Desai, said the company would apply for permission to have a single operator supervise several drones at once. "If regulators agree, the numbers start to look very different," she said. [4] The company has not yet decided whether to extend the trial to other regions.
question: What did the trial find?
choices: Drones were fast but expensive to operate.
Drones were unable to carry medicines.
Customers were generally unhappy with the service.
Drones were cheaper to run than vans.
answer: Drones were fast but expensive to operate.
explanation: 配達時間は大幅に短縮したが、1件あたりの費用はバンの約4倍だった。

MEMORANDUM
To: All Employees, Velmora Insurance
From: Human Resources
Date: April 3
Subject: Revised hybrid work policy

Following a review of last year's pilot program, Velmora will make hybrid working permanent from May 1. Employees in eligible roles may work from home up to two days per week, provided that their manager approves a fixed schedule in advance.

Tuesdays and Thursdays will be "team days," on which all staff are expected to be in the office. This is intended to make it easier to schedule meetings and training sessions.

Employees who wish to work from home must complete a home-office safety checklist, available on the HR portal. The company will provide each approved employee with a one-time payment of $250 toward the cost of a desk chair or monitor.

Roles that involve handling original customer documents are not eligible for hybrid work at this time.
question: What is the purpose of the memo?
choices: To invite staff to a training session
To ask for feedback on a pilot program
To describe a permanent policy change
To announce the end of hybrid work
answer: To describe a permanent policy change
explanation: 試行の結果、ハイブリッド勤務を5月から正式導入すると説明している。

passage:
Harlow Instruments Reports Lower Profit Despite Record Sales

Harlow Instruments, a manufacturer of laboratory testing equipment, reported record quarterly revenue of $412 million on Thursday, up 9 percent from the same period last year. Net profit, however, fell 14 percent to $31 million, as the company absorbed higher costs for electronic components and the expense of opening a new distribution center in Rotterdam.

Chief financial officer Marguerite Olsen told analysts that component prices had begun to stabilize and that the Rotterdam facility, which became fully operational in August, would reduce shipping costs to European customers by roughly a fifth. [1] "We made a deliberate choice to invest during a strong period of demand," she said.

Analysts were broadly sympathetic. [2] Several noted that the company's order backlog, a measure of future sales, stood at its highest level in five years. [3] Shares in Harlow fell 2 percent in early trading before recovering to close slightly higher. [4]
question: Why did Harlow's profit decline?
choices: It lost a major customer.
It closed a facility.
Its costs increased.
Its sales fell.
answer: Its costs increased.
explanation: 部品費の上昇と新物流センターの開設費用で利益が減った。売上は過去最高。

CITY OF WESTMERE — ROAD WORKS NOTICE
Kingsley Avenue Resurfacing

What: The section of Kingsley Avenue between Orchard Street and Bell Road will be resurfaced. New bicycle lanes will also be painted on both sides of the road.

When: Work will take place from August 4 to August 22, Monday to Friday, between 9:00 P.M. and 5:00 A.M. Work is scheduled at night to reduce disruption to traffic.

Effects: One lane will remain open in each direction at all times. On-street parking on this section will not be permitted during working hours. Bus routes 12 and 14 will operate as normal, but the stop outside Kingsley Library will be moved temporarily to Orchard Street.

Questions: Contact the Public Works Department at 555-0150.
question: What is the purpose of the notice?
choices: To announce a new bus route
To inform residents about upcoming road repairs
To ask residents for their opinions on new bicycle lanes
To report a traffic accident
answer: To inform residents about upcoming road repairs
explanation: Kingsley Avenue の再舗装工事を知らせる告知。
